intro: Kapitava Legit publishes a strong pitch and, a few clicks later, a set of qualifications that quietly change it. This review reads both in full.
The offer is a dashboard, a set of AI signals, and a broker relationship. You fund US$250, set risk preferences, and trade 12 assets automatically or by hand, with the demo alongside.
The scorecard reflects what the platform publishes, not what its ads promise. We checked the claims against the pages, looked for independent verification, and marked the gaps we found.
whatItClaims: 12 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.

steps.title: Register

pros: Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
Signals across 12 assets.
A practice account for learning.
cons: Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.
A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.

faqs.a: 12 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: For a cautious newcomer, Kapitava Legit can work: start on the demo, deposit the US$250 minimum and keep your own numbers.
4.8 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
